name: w2-evidence-linter-hidden
description: E2 workload W2, the HIDDEN evaluator: twelve contracts over the evidence-discipline linter after docs/requirements-delta.md, with data no arm is shown (different documents, run ids, file names and figures from the public examples). Never given to any arm; evaluated by AISEF's probes on each frozen candidate (validation/experiments/harness.py evaluate).

requirements.text: A --root that names a directory is walked recursively; every file under it ending in .md, .ts or .tsx is scanned in sorted path order; a directory whose name starts with '.' or is node_modules, build or dist is not entered.
A --root that names a path that does not exist is an error: one stderr message containing that path, nothing scanned, exit code 2.
--registry PATH names the run registry to read; without it the default infrastructure/ci/run_registry.json is read.

A registry that does not exist, cannot be read, is not JSON, or has no valid_runs list of strings is an error: load_run_registry (path a str or a Path) raises RegistryError (a ValueError) naming the path; cli_main prints one stderr line starting with 'run registry:', scans nothing and returns 2.
cli_main(argv) returns its exit code (0, 1 or 2) and never calls sys.exit itself.
--format json prints to stdout exactly one JSON document, the same document --report writes (findings, accepted_targets, accepted_placeholders); the exit code does not depend on --format.
--report keeps writing its document to the named file, byte-identical to today's output for the same scan.
infrastructure/ci/evidence_discipline.py imports nothing outside the Python standard library.
The citation, target:, observation-prefix, placeholder and fenced-code rules are unchanged.

notes/b.md.text: Sustained ingest reached 1024 rps on the second node.

notes/a.md.text: Cold start took 7 seconds on the first boot.

contracts.rationale: 1.1-1.2 hidden: a directory root is walked in sorted order (a.md, b.md, then c.ts — a .ts file is scanned); build, dist, node_modules and a .txt file are not scanned (every excluded file carries the figure 4 gb, which must not appear). A '.'-prefixed directory cannot be named in a cli_invocation workspace (aisef2/probe/cli_invocation.py _NAME: a segment starts with [A-Za-z0-9_]), so that half of 1.2 is not observed here
1.4 hidden: a root that does not exist is exit 2 with the path on stderr

claims.md.text:
Steady throughput was 1024 rps (run_id w2-hidden-run-07)
Peak memory: 12 GB, run_id: w2-hidden-run-09

contracts.rationale: 2.1 hidden: both citation forms against the named registry are accepted
2.2 hidden: valid_runs that is a string, not a list, is a malformed registry: exit 2, the 'run registry:' line names the path
2.2-2.3 hidden: a registry file that does not exist makes cli_main return 2 (no sys.exit, no silent empty registry)

2.2 hidden: a registry that is JSON but not a JSON object (a list) makes load_run_registry raise RegistryError, the type the delta names (a ValueError subclass; the path in its message is observed by H-REG-BAD's stderr). At the baseline the function returns an empty set, or raises AttributeError on a str path

claims.md.text: Sustained ingest reached 1024 rps on the second node.

contracts.rationale: 3.1 hidden: --format json prints exactly one JSON document and nothing else on stdout (anchored: an object from the first non-blank byte to the last; a text report before or after it refutes) holding the report keys and the finding's figure; exit 1 as there is a finding. A stream shape holds one key, so the figure is in the regex, not a second contains
3.1-3.2 hidden: with no finding, --format json still prints exactly one JSON document (findings empty, one accepted target) and the exit code is 0 — the exit code does not depend on --format
4.3 hidden: a figure cited to a run id of the default registry is accepted (true at the baseline)

```
cold start 99 seconds inside a fence
```

observed: cold start 7 seconds

contracts.rationale: 4.3 hidden: the target: line and the fenced line are not reported, the observed: line is (true at the baseline)
3.2 hidden: --report writes today's document byte for byte (true at the baseline)
4.2 hidden: no import statement of the linter names a module outside the standard library (true at the baseline)
